name: @brainagent/agent
description: Python voice runtime (LiveKit Agents). Scripts delegate to uv so Turborepo runs it with the rest.

scripts.setup: uv sync && uv run python -m brainagent_agent.worker download-files
scripts.dev: sh -c 'uv run python -m brainagent_agent.chat_server & CHAT=$!; trap "kill $CHAT" EXIT INT TERM; uv run python -m brainagent_agent.worker dev'
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
